error.invalid_input: Enter a canonical local IPv4 address and valid credentials.

user.title: Configure an OpenQUII monitor
user.description: Configuration validates values offline and never opens a door. Each accepted Door 1 or Door 2 press sends one request with no automatic retry.

data_description.address: Literal private, link-local, or loopback IPv4 HTTP origin.
data_description.username: Username for the authenticated control header.
data_description.unlock_credential_mode: Choose explicitly whether the supplied value is plaintext or an already encoded SHA-256 digest.
data_description.unlock_password: Credential used only for an explicit door-control action. Digest mode requires exactly 64 hexadecimal characters.
